== Description ==

Feature-mat match during the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, between [[Brian Fred]] (left, sleeveless cutoff shirt, playing custom Karl Koenig Force Lightning card sleeves) and an opponent using custom ''Our Favorite DILF'' card sleeves (only hand visible at right).

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2026-worlds-mpls, Karl Koenig (KrazyKarl), 28 October 2026 (11:57 EDT): "This was the best dressed match at worlds." Original file name: IMG_1555.jpg (4284×5712, 3.1 MB); Slack file id F0CCS4YT953. Scaled here to 2555×3407 to fit the wiki's 2 MB upload limit.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Karl Koenig]] (Slack: KrazyKarl)
* '''Date:''' 28 October 2026 (Slack post date; tournament 23–25 October 2026).
* '''Identification:''' [[Brian Fred]] (left) identified by his sleeveless cutoff shirt ([[:File:2026 World Championship - IMG 1561.jpg]]) and thread replies noting his Force Lightning sleeves and cutoff ("The pressed shirt against the cutoff…"); opponent's face and body are out of frame.
